root_causes: The editor request did not receive the hard output rules enforced by deterministic validation.
The v8.1 service treated validation as permission to suppress a completed paid output.
Recovery discovery still searched for retired output keys and could not resume the staged attempt correctly.
corrected_contract: The editor receives every hard output limit before its planned paid call.
Every structurally readable paid response remains visible, auditable, and reusable.
A completed six-stage run always publishes its newly generated final prose.
Validation and critic failures are attached diagnostics, not publication vetoes.
A warned artifact is labeled published_with_warnings and is never mislabeled validated.
No automatic corrective calls are added and no prior Read substitutes for the new run.
